smartshots.settings.title: Smart Screenshots — settings
smartshots.settings.auto_enabled.tooltip: Regularly take "memory" shots while you play
smartshots.settings.interval.tooltip: Only active play time counts (not menus)
smartshots.settings.auto_hide_hud.toolti: Auto shots without the HUD and hand. Taken invisibly — the interface never flickers
smartshots.settings.auto_skip_idle.toolt: Skip the shot if you haven't moved since the last one
smartshots.settings.notify.tooltip: Advancement and meeting shots. Auto shots never notify
smartshots.settings.advancement.tooltip: Take a screenshot whenever you earn any advancement
smartshots.settings.adv_delay.tooltip: Small delay so the advancement toast is on the shot
smartshots.settings.organize.tooltip: Sort screenshots into world and server folders
In singleplayer, separate folders for Overworld, Nether and End
smartshots.settings.scene_analysis.toolt: Remember visible blocks, mobs and players for smart search
smartshots.settings.pause_button.tooltip: Show the "Screenshots" button in the Esc menu
smartshots.info.hint: LMB — highlight · Shift+LMB — find on all shots
smartshots.info.no_mask: Highlighting isn't available for this shot · Shift+LMB — find on all shots
smartshots.viewer.pick_hint: LMB — highlight · Shift+LMB — find on all shots
smartshots.filter.show_auto.tooltip: Show auto shots in the gallery
smartshots.settings.manual_height.toolti: Maximum height of F2 and advancement shots. "Original" keeps the screen size. Images are scaled down smoothly (area averaging), aspect ratio kept, never upscaled
smartshots.settings.auto_height.tooltip: Maximum height of interval shots. 1080p takes about 4 times less space than 4K
smartshots.settings.archive_enabled.tool: Shrink and recompress shots older than the limit in the background. Favorites are never touched
smartshots.settings.archive_days.tooltip: Compress shots taken before this many days ago. Each shot is compressed only once
smartshots.settings.archive_height.toolt: Height old shots are scaled down to. "Original" only recompresses losslessly and keeps the size
smartshots.settings.archive_auto_only.to: Only compress interval shots; leave F2 and advancement shots alone
smartshots.settings.archive_now.tooltip: Compress every eligible shot right now with the settings above, even if background compression is off. File names, search and highlights keep working
smartshots.settings.archive_now.hint: Apply the archive settings to all old shots
smartshots.archive.running: Compressing, this may take a couple of minutes…
smartshots.archive.nothing: Nothing to compress — eligible shots are already archived
smartshots.archive.toast.title: Screenshot archive
smartshots.settings.meet: Shot when meeting a new player
smartshots.settings.meet.tooltip: Take a screenshot the first time you ever see another player, once they are well in view. Remembered across all worlds, servers and launcher instances
smartshots.settings.meet_gather.tooltip: After the first new player is in frame, wait this long so others arriving with them get on the same shot
smartshots.settings.meet_cooldown.toolti: Min time between two meeting shots. New players seen meanwhile share one shot after the pause
smartshots.settings.meet_block_sub.toolt: No meeting shots in this part of the server or world (e.g. a lobby). Shown only while you are in a world
smartshots.settings.meet_block_all.toolt: No meeting shots anywhere in this whole server or world
smartshots.settings.meet_forget.tooltip:
Clear the list of players you have met, in every instance. You'll get a meeting shot with each of them again.
File: %s
smartshots.copy.fail: Couldn't copy (needs wl-copy or xclip on Linux)
smartshots.share.confirm.title: Upload the screenshot?
smartshots.share.confirm.message: It will be uploaded to %s. Anyone with the link can see it, and it can't be deleted from there. The service can be changed in the settings.
smartshots.editor.title: Editor
smartshots.editor.cleared: All edits removed — Ctrl+Z brings them back
smartshots.editor.hint.move: Drag anything you drew; drag the empty image to pan
smartshots.editor.hint.arrow: Drag from the tail to the tip · Shift snaps to 15°
smartshots.editor.hint.text: Click and type · Enter finishes, Shift+Enter new line · click a text to edit it
smartshots.editor.hint.spotlight: Drag around what matters, the rest gets darker
smartshots.editor.hint.crop: Drag the new frame · RMB removes the crop
smartshots.editor.hint.eraser: Click or drag over a drawing to remove it
smartshots.editor.hint.common: RMB erases · wheel zooms · Ctrl+wheel size · Space/MMB pans
smartshots.settings.copy_on_capture.hint: Right after the shot is saved
smartshots.settings.copy_on_capture.tool: Image: paste the picture anywhere. File: paste it as a file attachment (Discord, Telegram, file manager). Link: upload and copy the link
smartshots.settings.auto_upload.tooltip: Upload every F2 shot right away; the link appears in chat
smartshots.settings.upload_service.hint: Anyone with the link can see the image
smartshots.settings.upload_service.toolt: catbox.moe keeps files forever, Litterbox deletes them after the time below, 0x0.st keeps them 30 days to a year. Custom: your own server or a service like imgur
smartshots.settings.custom_upload.toolti: Any host that takes a multipart file upload (ShareX-style)
smartshots.custom_upload.title: Custom upload service
smartshots.custom_upload.json.hint: data.link — empty: the first URL in the response
smartshots.settings.track_enabled.toolti: Where you go, in which world, when and how fast, plus every inventory change — to files with exact timestamps
smartshots.settings.track_interval.toolt: How often the position is written while you move (when standing still — every 5 s). 0.25 s takes about 1 MB per hour of play
smartshots.settings.track_folder.tooltip: One CSV of movement and one JSONL of inventory changes per play session, sorted by world and server
smartshots.editor.tool.caption: Caption
smartshots.editor.hint.sticker: Click to place an item, mob or player head
smartshots.editor.hint.caption: Date, place and coordinates in a corner
smartshots.sticker.title: Sticker
smartshots.sticker.failed: Couldn't make a picture of this item
smartshots.sticker.skin_loading: The skin is still loading, click again in a moment
smartshots.caption.title: Caption
smartshots.viewer.map.elsewhere: The map only shows the world and dimension you're in now
smartshots.settings.xaero_waypoints.tool: Waypoints at every screenshot of this world in Xaero's Minimap and World Map (not saved to Xaero's waypoints)
smartshots.settings.xaero_auto.tooltip: Also show interval shots (there can be a lot)
